---
engine: markdown
title: "Introduction to Quarto"
---

Learn to write with **Markdown**, turn text and R code into reports and slides with **Quarto**, and publish a **website** on GitHub Pages. This is how the [NV OSE training site](https://nv-ose.github.io/training/) you're reading right now is built.

## Overview

- **Audience:** Anyone who writes reports, presentations, documentation, or trainings, especially if you use R
- **Level:** Beginner (no Markdown or Quarto experience needed)
- **Duration:** About 5 hours, in three sessions (below)
- **Format:** Workshop or self-paced
- **Editors:** Instructions for **Positron**, **VS Code**, and **RStudio**. Pick your editor once in any tab set, and every page follows your choice.

## Learning objectives

By the end of this training, you will be able to:

1. Write formatted text in **Markdown**, and explain what Quarto adds to it.
2. Describe what Quarto is used for, and install it.
3. Add callouts, tabs, figures with alt text, and R code chunks to a Quarto document.
4. Create an **HTML report** that combines text, code, tables, and charts.
5. Build a **slide presentation** with revealjs.
6. Create a **website**, publish it on **GitHub Pages**, and keep it updated.
7. Make your Quarto outputs accessible.
8. Add a new training to the NV OSE training site.

## Prerequisites

- **Session 1:** none. Install [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/), [R](https://cran.r-project.org/), and an editor ([Positron](https://positron.posit.co/), [VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/), or [RStudio](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/)) as part of [Lesson 2](02-setup.qmd).
- **New to Positron?** The 45-minute [Introduction to Positron](../intro-to-positron/index.qmd) covers the editor first.
- **Session 3 (publishing):** a GitHub account and [GitHub Desktop](https://desktop.github.com/download/). The [Introduction to Git and GitHub](../intro-to-github/index.qmd) training first is recommended.

Basic R helps but isn't required. The code examples are short and explained.

::: {.callout-note}
On a state computer you may need IT to install Quarto, R, or an editor. Request them ahead of time.
:::
